limits: Pier, girder, joist and bearing dimensions are unverified structural sizing assumptions; loads, deflection, connections, foundations and capacity not certified.
Western vestibule uses flat timber ceiling under link; no low pointed masonry arch imposed. Eastern vestibule remains taller.
Roof clearance checked against this generated roof skin only; future rafters, ties, linings and services must retain the reserved envelope.
Roof flashings, gutters, valleys, drainage and weatherproof junction details remain design work.
3D walls are schematic extrusions of R04 plan cuts; full window/door heads, room ceilings and historic details are not modeled.
No approved cathedral geometry or working vault generator changed. F5ZL-C missing support schedule remains unresolved.
